items.quote: API Type: GraphQL - The platform uses a GraphQL API as its primary interface for developers.
Admins and permitted Members can create personal API keys from Settings > Account > Security & Access.
Create and manage webhooks and OAuth applications in Settings > Administration > API.
For each key you create, you can choose to give it full access to the data your user can access, or restrict it to certain permissions.
Linear's MCP server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so the server is centrally hosted and managed.
The Linear MCP server has tools available for finding, creating, and updating objects in Linear like issues, projects, and comments
